verdict.rationale: Featurebase closes the loop by automatically notifying all relevant users when their requests ship [docs-12], and it offers a unified inbox for replying to customers across in-app, Slack, Discord and email [docs-11]. Nothing shows a PM replying to a customer from inside the feedback post itself; the inbox appears to be a separate support surface, and the shipped notification is automated rather than a direct reply. Missing for 10: documented reply or comment-to-submitter from within the feedback record, a link between feedback posts and inbox conversations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
